result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a high-visibility continental crosswalk, sidewalks, and traffic signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to multiple lanes of traffic in a commercial environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflicts
hazards.description: The corner gas station creates multiple conflict points where vehicles may turn across the sidewalk or crosswalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection at the gas station entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals adjacent to a multi-story residential building. However, the wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance

hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner near the apartment building.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide arterial intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the environment is dominated by multi-lane vehicle traffic and conflict points from an adjacent gas station driveway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crosswalk spanning the width of the arterial road.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: The gas station entrance is located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, creating potential conflicts with turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the sidewalk meets the Sunoco lot.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down vehicles turning into or out of the side street.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
